rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a hotel in everyday Hong Kong speech.

example.english: This hotel is close to the MTR station, so staying one night is pretty convenient.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店近地鐵站，住一晚都幾方便。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6 zyu6 jat1 maan5 dou1 gei2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: A speaker uses this more formal term for a lodging establishment, especially when the emphasis is on accommodation rather than the everyday hotel label.

example.english: This hotel specializes in accommodating long-term travelers.
example.traditional: 呢間旅館專門接待長期旅客。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 leoi5 gun2 zyun1 mun4 zip3 doi6 coeng4 kei4 leoi5 haak3
